meta.notes: Continental US silhouette. Terrain paints the coastline. STATE → territories. No leaping: travel only on adjacent roads. California (Sacramento, Los Angeles) and Nevada (Reno, Las Vegas) join on deliberate border roads. Gulf Sealift stays St. Louis → gulf water → Cuba.
meta.unlock: All US/Yukon cities, including California and Nevada, are painted and walkable from week 0. Week 0 starts in contested Cheyenne, on the Stall corridor. Foreign nodes unlock at campaign phase 3. Gulf Sealift opens with those desks — Cuba is not a direct road from St. Louis.

sponsor.name: Peninsula — Korea
sponsor.copy: A far-shore desk offers crates to the occupation. That country is now a takeable front.

chronology.note: Locked phase names on the dock. California and Nevada are states on the outline, not phase banners. Ridge Runners is copy for the Front Range cell, not a new owner. Nuke scars are tags only where a city already exists.

rows.name: Invasion Day
rows.scan: Bering + Rio Grande. Omaha scar only.
rows.coach: Invasion Day is past. Bering and the Rio Grande. Omaha carries the only scar tag. No new cities.
rows.tick: Invasion Day is past. Omaha keeps the scar tag.

rows.name: Stall
rows.scan: Cheyenne to Kansas and Missouri. No Canada.
rows.coach: Stall. Winter dig-in from Cheyenne into Kansas and Missouri. The line never crosses into Canada.
rows.tick: Stall. Winter dig-in from Cheyenne toward Kansas and Missouri.

rows.name: Advent Crown
rows.scan: First offensive fails. Seattle, Cheyenne, St. Louis.
rows.coach: Advent Crown. The first offensive fails and stalls. Pressure sits on Seattle, Cheyenne, and St. Louis.
rows.tick: Advent Crown. The first offensive fails. Seattle, Cheyenne, and St. Louis take the pressure.

rows.name: Prairie Fire
rows.coach: Prairie Fire. Ridge Runners break out west to east on the states already on this board.
rows.tick: Prairie Fire. Ridge Runners move with the west-to-east breakout.

rows.name: Gulf Hammer
rows.subtitle: Long Rifle
rows.coach: Gulf Hammer. Long Rifle. The gulf gate is St. Louis, then Gulf Sealift. No new gulf-coast cities.
rows.tick: Gulf Hammer. Long Rifle. St. Louis is the gulf gate.

rows.name: Border Fury
rows.scan: Clear the states still short on this board.
rows.coach: Border Fury. Clear the states still short — plains, California, and Nevada.
rows.tick: Border Fury. Clear the states still short on this board.

rows.name: Foreign desks
rows.scan: Russia via Bering. Cuba via Gulf Sealift.
rows.coach: Foreign desks. Russia by the Bering road. Cuba and Nicaragua by Gulf Sealift.
rows.tick: Foreign desks. Russia by the Bering road. Cuba and Nicaragua by Gulf Sealift.
